svg.title: The same letters occur in different mathematical roles in this long construction. In particular, Lp is a physical period, whereas Li is an integer block ratio; m is the dimension of the given matrix representation, whereas m(q) below is a Fourier multiplier. The context and arguments distinguish these uses. The reference coupling bβi is a prescribed clock, while an unadorned βi is the actual calibrated coupling. They agree only to the extent established by the running estimates. None of the estimates below permits substituting an arbitrary covariance for the particular positive covariance supplied by its construction.
